evaluations.evidence: search and discover music using content identification or fingerprinting
evaluations.rationale: No other story forbids or constrains fingerprint-based search in a way that is incompatible; other discovery methods are complementary.

evaluations.evidence: search and discover music based on my profile
evaluations.rationale: Profile-based discovery is compatible with other search/recommendation approaches; no contradictory rule appears elsewhere.

evaluations.evidence: based on other users similar to myself
evaluations.rationale: Collaborative filtering-style discovery does not conflict with other discovery stories; they can coexist as alternative features.

evaluations.evidence: music or ringback tones similar to a given music video based on content similarity
evaluations.rationale: Content-similarity discovery is additive and not incompatible with other search/recommendation mechanisms in the backlog.

evaluations.evidence: exploiting enriched metadata and image tags
evaluations.rationale: Using metadata/tags for discovery does not contradict any other story; it complements other search inputs.

evaluations.evidence: upload tagged videos and have tags available for all further processing steps

evaluations.evidence: view thumbnail sequences of video segments
evaluations.rationale: Thumbnail viewing does not impose constraints that conflict with other segmentation/annotation stories.

evaluations.rationale: General similarity information is compatible with perceptual similarity (ZO-009) and other recommendation features; no incompatibility is specified.

evaluations.evidence: get info about perceptually similar video items and segments
evaluations.rationale: Perceptual similarity is a refinement/variant of similarity and does not contradict ZO-008 or other stories.

evaluations.evidence: receive content recommendations from similar profiles

evaluations.evidence: recommendations based on most relevant news events in my area
evaluations.rationale: Location/news-based recommendations can coexist with profile-based recommendations; no story states recommendations must be exclusively one type.

evaluations.evidence: identify persons in videos, and receive related information
evaluations.rationale: Person identification is compatible with product/brand/logo identification stories; no mutual exclusion is stated.

evaluations.evidence: identify products in videos
evaluations.rationale: Product identification does not conflict with other identification or filtering stories; they can be parallel analyses.

evaluations.evidence: identify broadcaster logos in videos
evaluations.rationale: Logo identification is compatible with other recognition and annotation tasks; no contradictory constraints are present.

evaluations.evidence: identify brands in videos
evaluations.rationale: Brand identification can coexist with product/person/logo identification; no story prohibits it.

evaluations.evidence: take a picture or upload an image ... recommended with videos related to that picture
evaluations.rationale: Image-based recommendation does not contradict other recommendation/search mechanisms; it is an additional input modality.

evaluations.evidence: access content using a geographical map and be informed if there are videos covering the area
evaluations.rationale: Map-based access is compatible with other discovery and recommendation stories; no conflicting access restriction is stated.

evaluations.evidence: assess how interesting or appealing or complex a picture is
